brief: a small hooded hero in a blue cloak for a top-down 16-bit style RPG

tickets.title: Sprite sheet SPR_PixelHero
tickets.instructions: Draw a small hooded hero in a blue cloak for a top-down 16-bit style RPG as 16x16 pixel art: idle (2 frames), walk (4 frames), for 4 directions, one row per animation and direction, in at most 16 colours with hard-edged transparency. Save it as res://art/pixel_hero.png.

produces.description: a small hooded hero in a blue cloak for a top-down 16-bit style RPG

tickets.title: Scene SCN_PixelHero
tickets.instructions: Make res://characters/pixel_hero.tscn: a CharacterBody2D with an AnimatedSprite2D whose SpriteFrames uses SPR_PixelHero's frames (animations idle, walk per direction, 8 fps), a CollisionShape2D sized to the feet, and a script that moves in four directions with the arrow keys and plays the matching walk animation. Run godot_check, then godot_run to make sure it loads without errors.

tickets.title: Verify SCN_PixelHero
tickets.instructions: Check every project script with godot_check, run res://characters/pixel_hero.tscn headless for 5 seconds with godot_run, and report each result as a test.
